d: Chayan Rastogi and Prashant Kapoor will discuss in this video... Team India somehow managed to turn a match that looked like a sure-shot victory into a draw against New Zealand! What went wrong for India, and was Shubman Gill responsible for letting this golden opportunity slip away? From questionable decisions and missed opportunities to India's performance on the field, we break down how a match that seemed firmly in India's control took a dramatic turn. Did Team India get too defensive, was the strategy flawed, or are fans justified in pointing fingers at Shubman Gill? Join Chayan…
